title: Annotatio V §.VIII open: Secunda Probatio — Oral tied to faith-foundation via solatii succus alone
pass_a_gloss: §. VIII. The Author’s Second Proof, by which in his Anti-Irenic Tract he had taught Oral Eating bound to the foundation of faith, was sought from the JUICE OF SOLACE ALONE, sought and placed by him in this Eating; But when I had shown that this Juice in no way flows from Oral Eating by this — that this Eating, on the Author’s hypothesis, is common to the impious or those eating unworthily, and so will supply not even a drop of solace, much less the whole juice.
pass_b_english: §.VIII: the Author’s second Anti-Irenic proof tied Oral eating to the faith-foundation by the juice of solace alone sought in that eating.
Strimesius had shown that juice cannot flow from Oral — on the Author’s own hypothesis Oral is common to the unworthy, so it yields not even a drop of solace.
source_text: §. VIII. Secunda Probatio Autoris, quâ Oralem Manducationem, fundamento fidei innexam, in Anti-Irenico suo Tractatu docuerat, à SOLO SUCCO SOLATII petita erat, in hac Manducatione ab eo quæsito repositóque; Cùm verò Succum hunc ex Orali Manducatione haudquaquam fluere per id ostendissem, quòd hæc impiis, seu indignè manducantibus, ex hypothesi Autoris, communis est, ne guttulam quidem solatii, nedum integrum succum suppeditatura.

lemmas.gloss: from the JUICE OF SOLACE ALONE
not even a drop of solace
